subject: StrataCorp CXO Onsite: Ambassador onboarding & travel playbook
messages:
From: Daniel Harris <daniel.harris@stratacorp.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: StrataCorp EA <ea@stratacorp.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: CXO visit — arrival window & EA handoff

Hi Olga,

Quick note as we firm up the visit: our CEO (Daniel Harris) and CAO (Emily Cho) will be in SF the week of Nov 16 for the joint workshop. Their EAs asked me to coordinate arrival slots and any special in-office requirements (secure briefing room, AV, and a private lunch space).

Can Redwood provide an "ambassador" point who will meet them at the airport/hotel and manage the EA handoff on the morning of Nov 17? Also please confirm whether the executive briefing can be printed and pre-staged in a sealed envelope for each CXO.

Thanks — Daniel
Daniel Harris | CEO, StrataCorp
[External]

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Daniel Harris <daniel.harris@stratacorp.com>, StrataCorp EA <ea@stratacorp.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CXO visit — arrival window & EA handoff

Hi Daniel / Emily (cc EAs),

Welcome — wed be happy to support. High level plan below; Ive looped in Laura (EA ops) and Tessa (VP events) to finalize logistics.

Summary plan (draft):
- Ambassador pickup: Redwood rep (Marcus Lin) will meet at SFO arrivals on Tue Nov 16, estimated between 13:30–14:30 PDT depending on flights. He will escort to the Ritz (booking attached) and confirm a 15–20 minute EA handoff.
- Onsite briefing: Nov 17, 09:00–11:30 in Redwood HQ, Conf Room A (secure, lockable). AV: projector + laptop input + live captioning.
- Private lunch: 12:00–13:00, Executive Dining Suite B (quiet).
- Briefing materials: printed, sealed envelopes for each CXO and one presenter packet; also a digital copy on an encrypted USB in the secure envelope.

Next steps for you: confirm arrival times or grant access to the EAs travel itinerary. For Redwood team: Laura/Tessa, please confirm Marcuss availability to be ambassador and attach final hotel confirmation.

Ill assemble a one-page playbook for EAs with pickup point, phone numbers, and escalation contacts. Attaching current itinerary draft.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: itinerary_v1.pdf (PDF, 87KB)]

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 13:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CXO visit — arrival window & EA handoff

Olga — I can take lead on the EA playbook. Marcus confirmed he can do pickup Nov 16. Ive requested the hotel confirmation from our travel team and will push the final RSVP to the venue (Conf Room A).

Ill prepare:
- One-page EA playbook (meeting point, phone numbers, contingency plan)
- Meeting access list and escort badges for both CXOs
- Sealed envelopes printed and staged with EAs initialing on arrival

Adding an access token for IT to unlock the secure room; Tessa, can you confirm catering order for a low-profile, gluten-free-friendly lunch?

—Laura
Laura Bennett | Executive Programs Manager, Redwood Inference

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CXO visit — arrival window & EA handoff

Thanks team — catering confirmed: boxed executive lunch (options: salmon/veggie/chicken), discrete service, noon delivery to Suite B. AV vendor scheduled for a dry run on Nov 16 at 16:00.

Ill also coordinate with Security for escorting the CXOs from lobby to Suite B and will add the secure USB protocol to the playbook. Attaching updated itinerary v2.

-Tessa
VP, Executive Events | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: itinerary_v2.pdf (PDF, 94KB)]

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai

Daniel / Emily — attaching the finalized playbook and hotel reservation. Key points: Marcus will meet arrivals at SFO (baggage claim 3) at 13:15 on Nov 16 and bring a sealed envelope with the printed brief. On Nov 17 well hold the briefing from 09:00–11:00, followed by private lunch.

Attached: itinerary_v3.pdf (final), hotel_reservation-stratadbl.pdf, redwood_exec_brief.pdf.

Please reply with any changes to arrival / departure times; otherwise well proceed as planned.

Safe travels — looking forward to hosting.

Olga
Senior Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
[Attachments: itinerary_v3.pdf (final); hotel_reservation-stratadbl.pdf (PDF, 42KB); redwood_exec_brief.pdf (PDF, 210KB)]
